executive_summary: Preferred dates Feb 15–18, 2027 begin on Monday Feb 15, which is Washington's Birthday (Presidents' Day). The U.S. Office of Personnel Management lists it as a federal holiday. [OPM 2027 holidays](https://www.opm.gov/policy-data-oversight/pay-leave/federal-holidays/)

The 2026 Michelin Southwest selection for Las Vegas has 24 listings: 4 with stars (Joël Robuchon 2★; L'Atelier, é by José Andrés and Restaurant Guy Savoy 1★ each), 3 Bib Gourmand and 17 Recommended or Selected. [LVCVA Michelin page](https://www.visitlasvegas.com/michelin-guide-restaurants/)

Area labels for the 24 listings are inconsistent across sources (several are 'per LVCVA' with no address), so distance from each hotel is unverified. Travel times by subway or bus (the brief's 1-hour rule) are not yet retrieved from RTC.

Hotel ranking (same-resort Michelin listings only, NOT the brief's 1-hour rule): 1) Venetian incl. Palazzo (4 listings, 0 stars); 2) MGM Grand (2 listings, 3 stars: Robuchon 2★, L'Atelier 1★); 3) Cosmopolitan (2 listings: é 1★, China Poblano Bib); 4) Caesars (1 listing, 1★ Guy Savoy); 5–8) ARIA, Bellagio, Resorts World, Wynn (1 listing each, 0 stars).

Room fit verified on official pages: Cosmopolitan 'City Room Queen' (2 queen beds, max 4) and ARIA 'Deluxe Two Queen Room' (2 queen beds). Private bathroom is not stated on any retrieved official room page — unverified.
PRICES ARE NOT VERIFIED. No official rate for Feb 15–18 or Feb 15–22, 2027 was retrieved. All hotel and per-person restaurant price cells are blank and flagged.

Booking timing (official): é by José Andrés takes reservations up to three months ahead, so the Feb 2027 dates fall inside that window now. LVCVA says most starred restaurants release tables 30–60 days ahead, which for a Feb 15 date means roughly Dec 17, 2026 – Jan 16, 2027 (derived, not a verified booking-date rule).

Activities: Red Rock Canyon is about 30 minutes from the Strip and needs timed entry Oct 1–May 31 (BLM). Hoover Dam is 30 miles southeast of Las Vegas (Reclamation). Valley of Fire's drive time is not on its official page.

Biggest blockers before a decision: hotel rates, bathroom/room specifics, restaurant per-person prices, social links, travel times, and your answers on trip length, budget and planned activities (see Questions).
